prompt_text: Who is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City to help me pick a plan?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” broker for everyone — the right broker depends on what type of coverage you need (individual/family, ACA/marketplace, Medicare, small‑group/employer, Medicaid, etc.), your ZIP code, and whether you prefer an independent broker or an agent who represents a particular carrier.

To help you quickly, tell me:
- Which type of plan (individual/family, employer/small group, Medicare, Medicaid)?
- Your ZIP code (or Kansas City, MO vs Kansas City, KS)?
- Any preferences (independent broker, no‑commission, in‑person meeting)?

How to find and vet good brokers in Kansas City
- Use official/local directories
  - HealthCare.gov “Find Local Help” for ACA marketplace agents and navigators.
  - Medicare.gov “Find a Medicare Agent or Broker” if you need Medicare.
  - State insurance department directories (Missouri Dept. of Commerce & Insurance; Kansas Insurance Dept.) to confirm licensure.
  - Local NAHU (National Association of Health Underwriters) chapters — they list member brokers.
- Check credentials and scope
  - Confirm they’re licensed in MO/KS and ask about certifications (e.g., AHIP for Medicare).
  - Ask whether they’re independent (can offer multiple carriers) or captive to one insurer.
- Ask these questions up front
  - Which carriers and plan types do you represent?
  - How long have you helped clients with my type of coverage?
  - Do you charge a broker fee or work on commission?
  - Can you provide client references or online reviews?
  - Will you help with enrollment, renewals, appeals, and claims support?
- Look for red flags
  - Pressure to buy a single plan without comparing options.
  - Refusal to disclose fees/commissions.
  - Lack of licensure or poor online reviews/BBB complaints.

If you want, I can:
- Pull a short list of well‑rated local brokers/agencies near your ZIP (I’ll need your ZIP and plan type).
- Draft a quick script/email you can use to contact brokers and compare them.

Which would you like me to do?
